questions.question_text: An effervescent antacid tablet has begun bubbling inside damp packaging. What most likely occurred?
questions.option_a: The tablet absorbed calcium from the air
questions.option_b: Moisture initiated its acid-carbonate reaction before use
questions.option_c: The tablet converted into an antibiotic
questions.option_d: Nitrogen in the package became liquid
questions.explanation: Effervescent formulations react with water to release gas; moisture can start the reaction during storage.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual verification: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: An ammeter is accidentally connected directly across a cell. Why can this be dangerous?
questions.option_a: It converts the cell into an insulator
questions.option_b: It raises the cell voltage without limit
questions.option_c: Its very low resistance can allow a large current
questions.option_d: Its very high resistance blocks all current
questions.explanation: An ammeter is designed for series connection and low resistance; a direct parallel connection can nearly short the source.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual verification: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: A convex lens forms a real image twice the object size. The object is 30 cm from the lens. How far from the lens is the image?
questions.explanation: For a real image, |v/u| = 2; with object distance 30 cm, image distance is 60 cm.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual verification: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php
